findings.text: — done-when clause 2 requires both "the same median over all runs" and "runs whose gate ran in the background, each listed by id", but a run whose gate ran in the background and cites no log reports no runner duration, and the tool-call fallback at line 48 cannot supply one (a backgrounded call returns from its tool call long before the gate finishes), so that run has no computable share and sits in neither median's population — the "all runs" figure is undefined for exactly the runs the same clause asks to be listed. WOULD_CHANGE_THE_PLAN: yes — REASON: without naming the all-runs denominator and how a no-duration run is treated, the node must guess, and the headline share can silently drop the long backgrounded gates this plan exists to measure.

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — every cited anchor resolves: `reckon/crew/node.py:1293`, `reckon/crew/routing.py:473` (`resolved_time_ceiling`, called at `reckon/crew/dispatch_plan.py:470`), `reckon/crew/prompts.py:382` and `:701`, `reckon/crew/recovery_stream.py:320`, `reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:337`, `reckon/schema/flight-defaults.yaml:201` (`enforce_budget_watchdog: false`), the plan `crew-observability-truth.html`, and the control run `r-20261018T084035535944-a-paired-arm-review-names-its-run` with `gate-after.log` reading "1 failed, 63 passed in 543.02s".
rubric_items.done_when: pass — done-when clause 3 declares the control that clause 1/2 needed: the deadline scan must report `_apply_budget_watchdog` and the timing scan must read the control run's 543.02 s from `gate-after.log`, both falsifiable.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the doc, script and figures sit on durable paths (`docs/research/`, `scripts/`, `docs/figures/`) inside the repository, and the 14-day measurement window is well inside the 30-day run-directory retention (`reckon/crew/gc.py:267,555`).
rubric_items.naming: pass — the new write paths (`how-much-of-a-node-is-its-gate`, `gate_share_of_run_time.py`) are named by what they measure, with no plan label, stage name, ticket number or version tag.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — the "all runs" median has no defined denominator for a backgrounded gate that cites no log.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §1 carries one deliverable: the read-only gate-share investigation (one doc, its script, its figures).
rubric_items.wiring: pass — s2 depends-on s1 and the `gate-time-shape` decision carries `data-sections="s2"`, so the open decision scopes to the section it gates rather than holding the whole plan.
